observed_value: principal_amount_usd is blank on FX01 issue rows
anchor_value: raw schedule presents the par amount column as dollar-denominated; example Fenix Intermediate LLC Term Loan B shows Par Amount $ 6,079,110

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Industry | Issuer | Acquisition Date | Investment | % of Net Assets | Par Amount | Maturity Date | Amortized Cost | Fair Value

rationale: FX01 is premised on non-USD source par requiring explicit FX conversion. The raw source schedule's par amount/cost/fair-value columns are dollar-denominated, and a representative flagged debt row has a dollar-sign par amount. Because the source does not show a non-USD principal requiring conversion, the FX01 flag is a rule-scope false alarm rather than a confirmed data error.
